categories.wheel-lathes_text: Re-profiling machines for wheelsets in service: underfloor, tandem, surface and portal designs for locomotives, coaches, EMUs, metros and wagons.
categories.wheel-axle-shop-machines_text: Machines for the wheel and axle shop – turning, boring, burnishing, pressing, measuring and balancing – for new builds and periodic overhaul.
categories.depot-workshop-equipment_text: Equipment that keeps a maintenance depot productive, from traction-motor armature work to train washing and shunting.
categories.partner-products_text: Selected products from international partners, supplied and supported in India by HYT.
